title.value: Establishing an Evaluation Metric to Quantify Climate Change Image Realism
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly mentioned in the header and throughout the text as the main focus of the study.
title.quote: Establishing an Evaluation Metric to Quantify Climate Change Image Realism

analysis.description: This paper focuses on evaluating the realism of images generated by a conditional generative model to illustrate climate change-induced flooding. The authors propose and assess automated and human-based methods for evaluating the realism of these generated images.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical analysis and experimentation with various evaluation metrics and their correlation with human judgment, which is characteristic of empirical research.
type.quote: we propose several automated and human-based methods for evaluation. To do this, we adapt several existing metrics, and assess the automated metrics against gold standard human evaluation.

name.justification: The research is primarily concerned with generating and evaluating images, a typical concern of the Computer Vision research field.
name.quote: We adapt several existing metrics, and assess the automated metrics against gold standard human evaluation...in the context of our image generation task.

name.justification: The paper is focused on evaluating a conditional generative model, which fits into the subfield of Generative Adversarial Networks.
name.quote: In this paper, we focus on the evaluation of a conditional generative model that illustrates the consequences of climate change-induced flooding.

name.justification: The paper addresses the challenge of communicating climate change through imagery, effectively contributing to the domain of Climate Change Communication.
name.quote: our project leverages the MUNIT architecture to perform cross-domain multimodal mapping...to visually represent the impact of climate change-induced flooding on a personal level.

name.justification: The MUNIT architecture is explicitly mentioned as the model used for generating the climate change-induced flooding imagery.
name.quote: our project leverages the MUNIT architecture to perform cross-domain multimodal mapping between a street-level image without any flooding to multiple versions of this image under diverse flood styles.

is_contributed.justification: The paper uses the MUNIT architecture, which is a pre-existing model and not a newly contributed model in this research.
is_contributed.quote: our project leverages the MUNIT architecture...

is_executed.justification: The model is executed to produce multiple versions of images demonstrating the impact of climate change.
is_executed.quote: our project leverages the MUNIT architecture to perform cross-domain multimodal mapping...to visually represent the impact of climate change-induced flooding.

is_compared.justification: The paper focuses on the evaluation metric rather than numerically comparing the MUNIT model with other models.
is_compared.quote: In this paper, we focus on the evaluation of a conditional generative model...

referenced_paper_title.justification: The referenced MUNIT architecture paper is listed in the references section (reference [8]).
referenced_paper_title.quote: Multimodal unsupervised image-to-image translation, Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), pp. 172–189, 2018.

name.justification: The Mapillary Vistas dataset is mentioned as a future potential dataset suitable for evaluating street-level scenery features similar to the study's domain.
name.quote: we are inclined to leverage other embedding spaces, e.g. the Mapillary or Cityscapes datasets, which could provide more suitable street-level scenery features that is similar to ours.
